description: NaLaP₂O₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.85 Å. La is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.92 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.62 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.63 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, two equivalent La, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one La, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two equivalent La, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na, one La, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two P atoms.
